masthead.title: The Scientist, The Accord, and Eight O'Clock
masthead.oneLinePremise: A quiet kid who loves cards, a faded coupe that means freedom, and a steady weekly call build toward a father's plainspoken wisdom for Mia.

storyboardPrompt.fullPrompt: An eight-panel colour storyboard sheet from a feature animation studio's pre-production, arranged in two even rows of four panels on a warm off-white page. Each panel is a 16:9 landscape rectangle with a thin dark border, evenly spaced, with a small hand-written shot number in the corner of each panel. Painted digital storyboard art — soft loose brushwork, simplified appealing character shapes, minimal facial detail, strong atmospheric lighting and clear colour design in every panel. Rich saturated colour, warm and cinematic, in the style of a feature animation colour script. Not photorealistic, not flat vector, not line art. Panel 1 [shot 1]: Wide shot at eye level. Light olive @Shaz and light olive @Brother sit on rug watching TV, @Shaz with black sunglasses pushed up on his forehead. Warm daylight from window left, soft warm shadows, cozy muted greens and beige. Panel 2 [shot 4]: Medium shot at eye level. Light olive @Sister in muted plum hijab fully covering hair and hairline with no visible hair leans in, light olive @Shaz with sunglasses pushed up on his forehead clutches cards. Bright window key from left, warm soft shadows, playful warm yellows and plum. Panel 3 [shot 6]: Close-up at eye level. Light olive @Mom in deep teal hijab fully covering hair and hairline with no visible hair leans in, light olive @Shaz with sunglasses pushed up on his forehead looks up. Soft window light front left, glowing warm shadows, tender teal and cream tones. Panel 4 [shot 1]: Wide shot at eye level. Light olive @DadShaz with black sunglasses pushed up on his forehead stands by faded coupe door. Late afternoon sun from right, long warm shadows, dusty blues and warm concrete. Panel 5 [shot 5]: Medium shot at eye level. Light olive @DadShaz with black sunglasses pushed up on his forehead types at desk. Warm desk lamp key from left, cool evening shadows, amber and deep brown. Panel 6 [shot 2]: Close-up at eye level. Light olive @Wife in soft sage hijab fully covering hair and hairline with no visible hair smiles on video call. Soft phone glow front, dim night shadows, gentle sage and warm lamp gold. Panel 7 [shot 4]: Medium shot at eye level. Light olive @DadShaz with sunglasses pushed up on his forehead sits beside light olive @Wife in soft sage hijab fully covering hair and hairline with no visible hair. Window light from left, calm warm shadows, quiet creams and soft green. Panel 8 [shot 6]: Close-up at eye level. Light olive @DadShaz with black sunglasses pushed up on his forehead looks forward warmly. Soft window key front left, warm tender shadows, golden cream and warm brown. Cohesive colour design across the whole sheet. No text or writing in the panels other than the shot numbers. No watermark, no logos, no border around the page.
